description: PAID $0.01 USDC. Newly awarded U.S. federal prime contracts (or grants/loans via type) from the public USAspending.gov API, largest first: award id, prime recipient + UEI, amount, agency/sub-agency, NAICS, PSC, place of performance, dates, description, usaspending.gov link. Filters: type, state, state_scope (performance|recipient), naics (2/4/6-digit), psc, agency, min_amount, days (1-90, default 7; 90 for grants/loans), limit. DoD contracts appear after a 90-day delay. Covered by pass_day/pass_month. No charge on failure.

agency.description: Awarding agency abbreviation (VA, DHS, HHS, NASA) or name

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

naics.description: NAICS code(s) or 2/4/6-digit prefixes, comma list (contracts)

name: gov_contracts
title: New federal contract awards from USAspending.gov ($0.01)
